top_choice_rationale: P001 credits Holst (incretin physiology and GLP-1 secretion), Mojsov (the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) form) and Drucker (islet, gut and appetite actions and the case for therapy), three distinct steps that preceded any analogue. The discovery began in hormone physiology, has been confirmed over decades by independent groups and drugs, and shows large randomized outcome benefit in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease, so maturity is not in doubt. The three-name allocation and physiology-anchored citation are defensible, with the Mojsov priority question and Knudsen's exclusion noted as the main attribution risks; awarding nothing would withhold a mature, well-confirmed achievement.
